parameter_notes.initial_total_ammonia_mM: Reference starting pool: 4 mM. Sensitivity settings: 3.5 and 6 mM.
parameter_notes.initial_bcaa_mM: Reference baseline: 0.2 mM. Sensitivity settings: 0 and 0.4 mM.
parameter_notes.initial_other_organic_n_mM_N: Reference available organic nitrogen pool: 10 mM-N.
parameter_notes.gln_supplement_mM: E06 supplement: 15 mM. Basal Gln is estimated from E06.
parameter_notes.ammonia_release_per_gln: Glutaminase-pathway setting: 1 mol ammonia per mol Gln. Alternative settings: 0 and 0.5.
parameter_notes.bcaa_new_n_fraction_from_ammonia: Nitrogen-source allocation: 0.5. Sensitivity settings 0 and 1 each use recalibrated E07/E08 activities.
parameter_notes.q_activity_transfer: Scale factor from Gln-assay activity to the common simulation interval.
parameter_notes.n_activity_transfer: Scale factor from ammonia/BCAA-assay activity to the common simulation interval.
parameter_notes.temperature_C: Reference temperature for aqueous ammonia speciation: 30 C.
parameter_notes.ammonia_observation: NH4 maps the E08 ammonium readout; TAN selects total ammonia.
parameter_notes.illustrative_endpoint_hours: Set the assay duration to express normalized time in hours; null retains normalized time.
parameter_notes.design_thresholds: Engineering targets: Gln removal >=20%, peak ammonia <=105% of its initial value, and endpoint ammonia <= its initial value.
